item.title: North Korean Soccer Team Offended by 'Northern Side' Remark... Defector: "They Act That Way to Survive" (‘북측’ 발언에 긁힌 北축구팀… 탈북민 “살기 위해 저러는 것”)
item.description:
North Korean Soccer Team Offended by 'Northern Side' Remark... Defector: "They Act That Way to Survive" (‘북측’ 발언에 긁힌 北축구팀… 탈북민 “살기 위해 저러는 것”)

After the North Korean women's soccer team Naegohyang won the 2026 AFC Women's Champions League, they unilaterally walked out of the post-match press conference, taking issue with the phrase "North Korean women's soccer." Analysts suggest this sudden reaction stems from a mission to never align with the "puppet regime" and a drive for survival within the system. Lee Hyun-seung, a researcher who defected from North Korea in 2014, graduated from Columbia University's School of International and Public Affairs, and now works at the U.S. think tank Global Peace Foundation Institute (GPI), told this publication on the 23rd, "The expressionless and cold demeanor seen on and off the field is both a display of hostility toward South Korea and a result of a thorough survival instinct." (2026 아시아축구연맹(AFC) 여자 챔피언스리그 우승을 차치한 북한 내고향축구단이 우승 후 열린 기자회견에서 ‘북측 여자 축구’란 발언을 문제 삼아 일방 퇴장한 가운데, 이런 돌발 행동이 ‘괴뢰’와 절대 동조해선 안 된다는 사명과 체제 내 생존을 위한 것이란 분석이 나왔다. 2014년 탈북해 컬럼비아대 공공정책대학원을 졸업한 뒤 현재 미국 싱크탱크인 글로벌평화재단연구원(GPI)에서 활동하고 있는 이현승 연구원은 23일 본지에 “경기장 안팎에서 보이는 무표정과 냉담한 태도를 한국을 향한 적대감의 표출이자 철저한 생존 본능의 결과”라며 이같이 밝혔다.)

During the press conference, head coach Ri Yu-il responded to the phrase "North Korean women's soccer" by saying, "Use the proper name of the country," then left the press room with a stern expression. This prompted bewildered reactions from domestic and foreign journalists present. Researcher Lee explained, "The North Korean coaches and players who come to South Korea are not just athletes; they are sports warriors sent to do battle with 'the eternal enemy and primary hostile nation of North Korea, the Republic of Korea,' as directly reflected in Kim Jong-un's declarations. Borrowing North Korean terminology, they are fighters on the front lines of ideological revolution. Acting friendly—like taking cheerful photos with South Korean athletes or smiling and waving at welcoming crowds, as seen in past Olympics—would lead to fatal consequences." (리유일 감독은 이날 기자회견에서 ‘북측 여자 축구’란 발언에 “국호를 제대로 불러라”고 말한 뒤 굳은 표정으로 기자회견장을 빠져 나갔다. 이후 현장에 있던 내외신 기자들 사이에서 이해할 수 없다는 반응이 나왔다. 이 연구원은 “한국에 온 북한 감독, 선수들은 단순한 스포츠 선수가 아니고 김정은 정권의 선언에 고스란히 투영된 ‘북한의 영원한 적(敵)이자 제1적대국인 대한민국’에 전투를 하러 온 체육 전사들”이라며 “북한식 표현을 빌리자면 사상 혁명의 최전선에 서 있는 전투원들로 과거 올림픽에서처럼 한국 선수들과 다정하게 사진을 찍거나 환영단을 향해 손을 흔들며 웃음을 지었다가는 치명적인 결과로 이어질 것”이라고 했다.)

Following the Naegohyang team's visit to South Korea, a joint cheering squad was established to support them, with approximately 300 million won funded by the Ministry of Unification from the Inter-Korean Cooperation Fund. This squad unilaterally cheered for North Korea. After Suwon FC Women lost 1-2 in the semifinals, coach Park Gil-young said, "During the game, I felt a bit upset and uneasy." Researcher Lee noted, "At a time when Kim Jong-un has completely redefined inter-Korean relations as 'hostile two-state relations,' the South Korean government's vague hopes for inter-Korean exchanges through sports are fundamentally impossible for any North Korean resident or official. The unilateral interest and hospitality from the South Korean side are merely a dangerous one-sided crush that doesn't work on them, and instead drives North Korean players into a dead-end corner of personal threats." He added, "The more obsessed South Korean society becomes, the more arrogant the North Korean authorities will grow, raising the level of hostility toward South Korea. To save the North Korean players and their families, we must stop wasting unnecessary taxpayer money and treat sports as just sports." (내고향축구단 방한(訪韓)을 계기로 이 팀을 응원하는 공동응원단이 창설됐고, 통일부 주도로 남북협력기금에서 약 3억원이 지원됐다. 이 응원단은 북한을 일방적으로 응원했는데, 준결승에서 1대2로 패배한 수원FC 위민의 박길영 감독은 “경기하는 내내 조금 속상하기도 하고, 마음이 좀 그랬다”고 했다. 이 연구원은 “김정은이 남북 관계를 ‘적대적 두 국가 관계’로 완전히 재정의한 현시점에서 한국 정부가 막연하게 기대하는 스포츠를 통한 남북 교류는 북한 주민과 간부 그 누구에게도 원천적으로 불가능한 일”이라며 “한국 측의 일방적 관심과 환대는 저들에게 통하지 않는 위험한 짝사랑일 뿐이며 오히려 북한 선수들을 신변 위협의 막다른 골목으로 내모는 결과를 초래한다”고 했다. 그는 “한국 사회가 집착을 보일수록 북한 당국은 더 거만해지고 한국을 향한 적대 수위를 높일 것”이라며 “북한 선수와 그 가족을 살리기 위해서라도 불필요한 세금 낭비를 중단하고 스포츠는 스포츠로만 보아야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: The Paradox of the Trump Era... Korea-Japan Relations Growing Closer (트럼프 시대의 역설...더 가까워진 한일 관계)
item.description:
The Paradox of the Trump Era... Korea-Japan Relations Growing Closer (트럼프 시대의 역설...더 가까워진 한일 관계)

<<>> ()

'Era of Great Transformation: Toward a New Balance' ()

The (ALC), held annually by The Chosun Ilbo in Seoul, is a premier global forum that brings together world-class politicians, diplomatic and security experts, business leaders, and artists to examine the currents of the times. This year's conference, held over two days starting the 20th at The Shilla Hotel under the theme 'Era of Great Transformation: Toward a New Balance,' also garnered attention for its diverse global discourse. (‘대변혁의 시대: 새로운 균형을 향하여’)

I moderated a session on the first day of the ALC focusing on Korea-Japan relations and trilateral cooperation among South Korea, the U.S., and Japan. The session featured former Ambassador to Japan Park Cheol-hee, former U.S. Ambassador to South Korea Mark Lippert, and Koichi Hagiuda, Acting Secretary-General of Japan's Liberal Democratic Party (LDP), as representatives of the three countries. Seated in the front row was Akie Abe, wife of the late former Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe. This was a scene that would have been difficult to imagine just a few years ago. (매년 조선일보가 서울에서 개최하는 (ALC)는 세계 정상급 정치인과 외교·안보 전문가, 기업인, 예술가 등이 한자리에 모여 시대의 흐름을 살펴보는 대표적 글로벌 포럼입니다. 지난 20일부터 이틀간 신라호텔에서 ‘대변혁의 시대: 새로운 균형을 향하여’를 주제로 열린 올해 회의 역시 다양한 글로벌 담론으로 주목받았습니다.)

Secretary-General Hagiuda: "Ties Began During President Park Geun-hye's Era" (저는 ALC 첫째 날 한일 관계와 한미일 3국 협력을 주제로 한 세션 사회를 맡았습니다. 이날 세션에는 박철희 전 주일 대사, 마크 리퍼트 전 주한 미국 대사, 하기우다 고이치 일본 자민당 간사장 대행이 각각 한미일 3국 대표로 참석했습니다. 객석 맨 앞줄에는 고(故) 아베 신조 전 일본 총리의 부인인 아베 아키에 여사도 자리하고 있었습니다. 불과 몇 년 전만 해도 쉽게 보기 어려웠던 장면이었습니다.)

As the session began, Acting Secretary-General Hagiuda took out his prepared script and spoke for much longer than expected. A key aide to former Prime Minister Shinzo Abe, having served as Minister of Economy, Trade and Industry and LDP Policy Research Council Chairman, he introduced the starting point of his connection with Korea, saying it "began a decade ago during the era of former Prime Minister Shinzo Abe." He recalled being present as Deputy Chief Cabinet Secretary at the summit between President Park Geun-hye and Prime Minister Abe, noting that he has been involved in Korea-Japan relations ever since. (하기우다 간사장 “박근혜 대통령 때부터 인연”)

Hagiuda attached great significance to the ongoing shuttle diplomacy between the leaders of South Korea and Japan. He noted, "Just yesterday (the 19th), Prime Minister Takayoshi visited Andong, President Lee Jae-myung's hometown, for a summit, and before that in January, President Lee visited Nara, Prime Minister Takayoshi's constituency." He assessed this as "a symbolic scene showing the close trust between the leaders of both countries, with mutual visits occurring twice in just half a year." (세션이 시작되자 하기우다 간사장 대행은 준비해 온 원고를 꺼내 들고 예상보다 훨씬 긴 시간 동안 발언했습니다. 아베 신조 전 총리의 핵심 측근으로 경제산업상과 자민당 정조회장 등을 지낸 그는 자신과 한국의 인연이 시작된 계기를 “10년 전 아베 신조 전 총리 시절”이라고 소개했습니다. 당시 일본 내각관방 부장관으로 박근혜 대통령과 아베 총리 간 정상회담에 배석했던 경험을 떠올리며 이후 한일 관계에 관여해왔다고 했습니다.)

He particularly emphasized that "current Japan-Korea relations are developing smoothly in all areas, from politics and security to economy and culture, based on the strong trust between the leaders." He added, "Going forward, we will make the channels of dialogue and cooperation at all levels even thicker and stronger." (하기우다는 최근 이어지고 있는 한일 정상 간 셔틀 외교에도 큰 의미를 부여했습니다. 그는 “전날(19일) 다카이치 총리가 이재명 대통령의 고향인 안동을 방문해 정상회담을 가졌고, 이에 앞서 지난 1월에는 이 대통령이 다카이치 총리의 지역구인 나라를 방문했다”며 “불과 반년 사이 두 차례 상호 방문이 이뤄졌다는 것은 양국 정상 간 긴밀한 신뢰 관계를 보여주는 상징적 장면”이라고 평가했습니다.)

One of the most frequently used terms in Hagiuda's remarks that day was 'economic security.' Mentioning semiconductors, supply chains, rare earths, and the AI industry, he said, "I believe Japan and Korea are truly a community of fate even in economic terms, and we can further develop cooperation going forward." This seemed less like simple diplomatic rhetoric and more like an indication that the perception of South Korea's strategic value within Japanese political circles has significantly changed. (그는 특히 “현재 일한 관계는 양국 정상 간 강한 신뢰를 바탕으로 정치·안보는 물론 경제와 문화에 이르기까지 전 분야에서 원만하게 발전하고 있다”며 “앞으로도 모든 수준에서 대화와 협력의 통로를 더욱 굵고 강하게 만들어 가겠다”고 강조했습니다.)

Park Cheol-hee: "South Korea and Japan Must Sit on the Same Side" (이날 하기우다의 발언에서 가장 자주 등장한 단어 가운데 하나는 ‘경제안보’였습니다. 그는 반도체와 공급망, 희토류, AI 산업 등을 거론하며 “일본과 한국은 경제 측면에서도 확실히 운명공동체라는 점을 의식하면서 협력을 앞으로 더 발전시켜 나갈 수 있다고 생각한다”고 했습니다. 단순한 외교적 수사라기보다 일본 정치권 내부에서 한국의 전략적 가치에 대한 인식이 상당히 달라졌음을 보여주는 발언처럼 들렸습니다.)

Former Ambassador Park Cheol-hee, who has served as Dean of Seoul National University's Graduate School of International Studies and President of the Korea National Diplomatic Academy, stressed the imperative for Korea-Japan cooperation, stating, "We are now witnessing not an international order based on norms, but an international order that breaks norms." He argued that amid such chaotic international circumstances, "South Korea and Japan must sit on the same side, rather than taking different sides." He particularly emphasized the need to jointly protect 'international public spaces' like cyberspace, maritime space, and outer space. His point was that Korea-Japan relations should be viewed not merely through a bilateral lens but as a framework for cooperation to maintain the international order. (박철희 “한일은 같은 편에 앉아야 한다”)

What I paid close attention to was his mention of Global South issues, going beyond simple security cooperation. He stated the need for South Korea and Japan to jointly manage Official Development Assistance (ODA) and pursue talent development projects targeting the Global South. This stemmed from a recognition that Global South countries, which largely overlap with former non-aligned nations, are being marginalized amid great power competition, and that South Korea and Japan could play a joint role. I interpreted this as an argument that Korea-Japan relations should not be viewed merely as a bilateral relationship confined to historical issues, but should be elevated to a cooperative partnership that jointly designs the international order. (서울대 국제대학원장, 국립외교원장을 지낸 박철희 전 대사는 “우리는 이제 규범에 기반한 국제 질서가 아니라 규범을 깨는 국제 질서를 목격하고 있다”며 한일 협력의 당위성을 강조했습니다. 그는 이처럼 혼란한 국제 정세 속에서 “한국과 일본은 서로 다른 편에 서기보다 같은 편에 앉아야 한다”고 했습니다. 특히 사이버 공간과 해양 공간, 우주 공간 같은 ‘국제 공공 공간’을 함께 지켜야 한다고 주장했습니다. 단순히 양자 관계 차원이 아니라 국제 질서를 유지하기 위한 협력 틀로 한일 관계를 바라봐야 한다는 취지였습니다.)

Lippert: "What is the Common Vision Regarding China?" (제가 주목해서 들은 것은 그가 단순한 안보 협력을 넘어 글로벌 사우스 문제까지 언급했다는 점입니다. 그는 글로벌 사우스를 대상으로 한국과 일본이 공적개발원조(ODA)를 공동 운영하고 인재 양성 사업도 함께 추진할 필요가 있다고 했습니다. 과거 비동맹 국가들과 상당 부분 겹치는 글로벌 사우스 국가들이 강대국 경쟁 속에서 소외되는 상황에서, 한국과 일본이 공동 역할을 할 수 있다는 문제의식이었습니다. 이는 한일 관계를 단순히 과거사 문제에 갇힌 양자 관계로 볼 것이 아니라 국제 질서를 함께 설계하는 협력 관계로 끌어올려야 한다는 주장으로 읽혔습니다.)

Former Ambassador Mark Lippert began his remarks by saying, "It is a truly great honor to return to Korea, where both of my children (Jae-jun and Jae-hee) were born. I have many fond memories, so I try to come to Korea as often as possible." (리퍼트 “중국에 대한 공통 비전은 무엇인가”)

While introducing himself as "an avowed Democrat," Lippert tried to explain President Trump as objectively as possible. He said, "President Trump has a style that even surprises people in his own party." He added, "It's not particularly targeting South Korea or Japan." While the audience laughed, the reality was also palpable that Trump's unpredictable policies are a source of genuine anxiety for allied nations. (마크 리퍼트 전 대사는 “나의 두 자녀(세준·세희)가 모두 태어난 한국에 다시 오게 되어 진심으로 큰 영광”이라며 “좋은 추억이 많아 가능한 한 자주 한국에 오려고 한다”고 말하며 발언을 시작했습니다.)

He also emphasized that figures like Secretary of State and National Security Advisor Marco Rubio continue to value trilateral cooperation between South Korea, Japan, and the U.S. He highly praised the recent improvement in bilateral relations, noting, "Relations between South Korea and Japan have rarely been as good as they are now." Lippert also offered advice on future tasks. He stated, "Continued efforts are needed to secure strategic agreement on our direction in the Indo-Pacific," and added, "We need to more clearly define our common vision regarding China and our shared points of agreement concerning North Korea." (리퍼트는 자신이 “명백한 민주당원”이라고 소개하면서도 트럼프 대통령에 대해 최대한 객관적으로 설명하려 노력했습니다. 그는 “트럼프 대통령은 자기 당 사람들까지 놀라게 하는 스타일”이라며 “특별히 한국이나 일본만 겨냥하는 것은 아니다”라고 말했습니다. 좌중에서는 웃음이 나왔지만, 동시에 트럼프의 예측 불가능한 정책이 동맹국들에 실질적 불안 요인이 되고 있다는 현실도 느껴졌습니다.)

"Possibility of USFK Reduction?" (그는 마코 루비오 국무장관 겸 국가안보보좌관 등이 한미일 협력을 계속 중시하고 있다는 점도 강조했습니다. 특히 “한일 관계가 지금처럼 좋았던 적은 거의 없었다”며 최근 양국 관계 개선을 높이 평가했습니다. 리퍼트는 앞으로의 과제에 대해서도 조언했습니다. 그는 “인도·태평양에서 우리가 나아갈 방향에 대한 전략적 합의를 확보하기 위한 지속적 노력이 필요하다”며 “중국에 대한 공동 비전은 무엇인가, 북한에 대한 공통된 합의점은 무엇인가를 보다 명확히 정립해야 한다”고 말했습니다.)

The possibility of a reduction in U.S. Forces Korea (USFK) was also discussed during the meeting. Lippert and I had the following exchange: (“주한 미군 감축 가능성은?”)

- Lately, among the ROK-U.S.-Japan triangular relationship, it seems the ROK-U.S. relationship might be the most tense. Especially after President Trump announced a reduction of over 5,000 U.S. troops in Germany, concerns are spreading about whether USFK might also be reduced. (이날 회의에서는 주한 미군 감축 가능성도 논의됐습니다. 저와 리퍼트는 이 같은 문답을 주고받았습니다.)

=What I want to say is that on this matter (regarding potential troop reductions), President Trump takes the military advice of the USFK commander very seriously. Currently, the U.S. military is focusing more on capabilities rather than the sheer number of troops. I think the Department of Defense's attempts to rationalize and normalize troop deployments are certainly meaningful. (During the Obama administration, I was the Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense for Asia-Pacific.) We examined more rational troop deployment options very closely. However, implementing them was far too costly at the time. The U.S. should not take this issue lightly and must approach it very carefully and thoughtfully. (- 최근 한미일 3각 관계 중에서 가장 긴장감이 있는 것이 한미 관계가 아닌가 싶습니다. 특히 트럼프 대통령이 독일 주둔 미군을 5000명 이상 감축하겠다고 한 후, 주한 미군도 감축되는 것 아니냐는 우려가 확산하고 있습니다. )

Lippert's remarks were interpreted to mean that while President Trump would heed the judgment of USFK Commander General Bronson, the role of USFK could involve reductions based on 'alliance modernization.' (=내가 말하고 싶은 것은 (미군 감축 여부와 관련한) 이 사안에 대해서는 트럼프 대통령이 주한 미군 사령관의 군사적 조언을 매우 진지하게 받아들인다는 점입니다. 현재 미군은 병력 수 자체보다는 역량에 초점을 맞추고 있습니다. 나는 국방부가 병력 배치를 합리화하고 정상화하려고 시도한 것은 분명 의미가 있다고 생각합니다. (오바마 행정부 시절 나는 국방부 아시아태평양 차관보였는데) 우리는 보다 합리적인 병력 배치안을 매우 면밀히 검토했습니다. 그런데, 당시 이를 실행하기에는 너무나 비용이 많이 들었습니다. 미국은 이 문제를 가볍게 여겨서는 안 되며, 매우 신중하고 사려 깊게 접근해야 합니다.) )

"ACSA is Ultimately Like Insurance" (리퍼트의 발언은 트럼프 대통령이 브런슨 주한미군 사령관의 판단에 귀 기울이겠지만, ‘동맹 현대화’에 따라 주한미군의 역할 및 감축이 가능할 수 있다는 뜻으로 받아들여졌습니다.)

Hagiuda drew attention during the Q&A session by revealing Japan's candid stance. When I asked, "What strategy does Japan have when dealing with non-traditional leaders like President Trump?", he smiled and replied, "We have no strategy," prompting laughter from the audience. His comment was taken as 'half-joking, half-serious.' (“ACSA는 결국 보험 같은 것”)

He acknowledged, "It's true that President Trump is not easy to deal with because he conducts very original diplomacy, unbound by past traditions or legacies." However, he added, "The Japan-U.S. alliance is the fundamental pillar of Japan's diplomatic and security policy, and we will maintain it unwaveringly." He continued, "Issues like this cannot be solved by Japan alone, so we must cooperate with South Korea," stressing, "We need to cooperate within the framework of Japan, South Korea, and the U.S. to ensure President Trump fully understands the situation in Northeast Asia." This was a statement underscoring the importance of Korea-Japan cooperation in an unprecedented era where it is difficult to trust the U.S. President, an ally. (하기우다는 Q&A 시간에 일본 측의 솔직한 입장을 드러내 주목받았습니다. 제가 “트럼프 대통령 같은 비전통적 지도자를 상대로 일본은 어떤 전략을 갖고 있느냐”고 묻자 그는 웃으며 “우리는 전략이 없습니다”라고 답해 청중석에서는 웃음이 터졌습니다. 그의 발언은 ‘농반진반’으로 들렸습니다.)

Regarding the Lee Jae-myung administration's passive stance on the Acquisition and Cross-Servicing Agreement (ACSA) between South Korea and Japan, former Ambassador Park Cheol-hee analyzed it as stemming from "the perception that there is public resistance." He explained, "There remains a sentiment that military cooperation with Japan could lead to Japan's re-entry into the Korean Peninsula." (그는 “트럼프 대통령이 과거의 전통이나 유산에 얽매이지 않고 매우 독창적인 외교를 전개하기 때문에 대응하기 쉽지 않은 것은 사실”이라면서도 “미일 동맹은 일본 외교·안보 정책의 기본축인 만큼 흔들림 없이 유지해 나가겠다”고 말했습니다. 이어 “이런 일은 일본 혼자만으로 해결할 수 없기 때문에 한국과 협력해야 한다”며 “일본·한국·미국의 3자 틀 안에서 협력해 트럼프 대통령이 동북아 상황을 충분히 이해할 수 있도록 해야 한다”고 강조했습니다. 동맹국 미국 대통령을 믿기 어려운, 이례적인 시대에 한일 협력의 중요성을 강조한 발언이었습니다.)

Citing the case where South Korean troops received ammunition support from the Japan Self-Defense Forces during the deployment to South Sudan, Park emphasized "the need for practical cooperation in preparation for contingencies." He argued that "ACSA is a kind of insurance" and urged its swift conclusion. (박철희 전 대사는 한일 상호군수지원협정(ACSA)에 대해 이재명 정부가 소극적인 이유와 관련해 “국민 정서상 저항감이 있다는 인식 때문”이라고 분석했습니다. 그는 “일본과 군사 협력을 하면 일본이 다시 한반도에 진출하는 것 아니냐는 감정이 아직 남아 있다”고 설명했습니다.)

Atmosphere Emphasizing 'Cooperation' Inside and Outside the ALC Venue (박 전 대사는 남수단 파병 당시 우리 군이 일본 자위대로부터 탄약을 지원받았던 사례를 언급하며 “유사시에 대비한 현실적 협력이 필요하다”고 강조했습니다. 그는 “ACSA는 일종의 보험 같은 것”이라며 시급히 체결할 것을 주장했습니다.)

This year's ALC also saw active networking events. During every break, participants naturally continued conversations about the U.S. strikes on Venezuela and Iran, U.S.-China conflict, supply chain and energy cooperation, the AI industry, and the North Korean nuclear issue. A natural consensus emerged that "the world is getting increasingly dangerous" and "liberal democratic countries must join forces." (ALC 회의장 안팎의 ‘협력’ 강조 분위기)

A particularly memorable scene was the dinner on the evening of the 20th. As key international participants were dining at different tables, one attendee remarked, "President Trump isn't entirely bad. His actions have made South Korea and Japan feel a sense of crisis and cooperate with each other, which is rather positive." This prompted laughter from the audience. (올해 LC에서도 장외 모임이 활발했습니다. 휴식 시간마다 참석자들은 미국의 베네수엘라·이란 공격, 미·중 갈등, 공급망과 에너지 협력, AI 산업, 북핵 문제 등을 놓고 자연스럽게 대화를 이어갔습니다. 자연스럽게 “세상이 갈수록 위험해지고 있다”, “자유민주주의 국가들이 힘을 합쳐야 한다”는 공감대가 형성됐습니다.)

What I felt at the ALC was that Korea-Japan relations are moving beyond an era explainable solely by historical issues. Amidst massive international geopolitical shifts like the Russia-North Korea alignment, U.S.-China strategic competition, supply chain restructuring, AI competition, and the Middle East crisis, South Korea and Japan increasingly need each other. The ALC made it clear that the less trustworthy the U.S. President seems and the more the international order shakes, the more Korea-Japan cooperation becomes not a choice but a strategic imperative. (특히 인상 깊었던 장면은 20일 저녁 만찬이었습니다. 각국의 주요 참석자들이 테이블별로 나뉘어 식사를 하던 중 한 인사가 “트럼프 대통령이 모두 나쁜 것만은 아니다. 한일 양국이 위기의식을 느끼고 서로 협력하게 만든 점은 오히려 긍정적”이라고 말하자 좌중에서 웃음이 터졌습니다.)

[P.S.] Busan World Heritage Committee and Japan (ALC 현장에서 느낀 것은 한일 관계는 이제 더 이상 과거사만으로 설명되는 시대를 지나고 있다는 점입니다. 북·러 밀착, 미·중 전략 경쟁, 공급망 재편, AI 경쟁, 중동 위기 같은 거대한 국제정세 변화 속에서 한국과 일본은 점점 더 서로를 필요로 하고 있습니다. 미국의 대통령이 믿음을 주지 못하고, 국제질서가 흔들릴수록 한일 협력은 선택이 아니라 전략적 필수가 되어가고 있음을 ALC에서 느낄 수 있었습니다.)

Acting Secretary-General Hagiuda showed the demeanor of a seasoned Japanese politician. He devoted a significant portion of his opening remarks to issues he particularly wanted to emphasize. Notably, he mentioned the 'Asuka-Fujiwara Palatial Sites,' which Japan is pushing to inscribe ahead of the 48th session of the World Heritage Committee in Busan this July. ([P.S.] 부산 세계유산위원회와 일본)

Hagiuda explained that the Asuka-Fujiwara Palatial Sites are a valuable cultural heritage demonstrating the birth and establishment of a centralized state system during the formation of ancient East Asian nations. He also publicly acknowledged that ancient Japanese culture was heavily influenced by the Korean Peninsula. He further expressed gratitude to South Chungcheong Province, which has a friendship agreement with Nara Prefecture, and Buyeo County, which has a sister-city relationship with the town of Asuka, for actively supporting the inscription bid. (하기우다 간사장 대행은 일본의 노련한 정치가다웠습니다. 그는 모두발언 상당 부분을 자신이 꼭 강조하고 싶은 현안에 할애했습니다. 특히 오는 7월 부산에서 열리는 제48차 세계유산위원회를 앞두고 일본이 등재를 추진 중인 ‘아스카·후지와라의 궁도(宮都)’를 거론한 것이 눈길을 끌었습니다.)

Hagiuda stated, "If this inscription is successful, it will give even greater momentum to Japan-Korea exchanges." Witnessing him seamlessly connect Korea-Japan relations, cultural exchange, and local exchange on the stage of an international conference, I was once again reminded of the meticulousness and strategy characteristic of Japanese politics. <<>> (하기우다는 아스카·후지와라의 궁도가 고대 동아시아 국가 형성 과정에서 중앙집권 체제가 탄생하고 확립되는 과정을 보여주는 귀중한 문화유산이라고 설명했습니다. 그는 일본 고대 문화가 한반도의 영향을 많이 받았다는 점도 공개적으로 언급했습니다. 이어 나라현과 우호 협정을 맺고 있는 충청남도, 그리고 아스카 마을과 자매결연 관계인 부여군이 이번 세계유산 등재를 적극 지원하고 있다는 점에 감사를 표시했습니다.)

item.title: North Korean Media Report "Our Hometown Team Wins" Without Mentioning Match Location (北 매체들 경기 장소 언급 없이 “내고향팀 우승”)
item.description:
North Korean Media Report "Our Hometown Team Wins" Without Mentioning Match Location (北 매체들 경기 장소 언급 없이 “내고향팀 우승”)

North Korean media outlets reported on the 24th that the "Our Hometown Women's Football Team" won the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) Women's Champions League (AWCL) final the previous day. However, they did not mention the fact that the match was held at Suwon Sports Complex in Gyeonggi Province. (북한 매체들은 24일 전날 아시아축구연맹(AFC) 여자 챔피언스리그(AWCL) 결승전에서 ‘내고향여자축구단’이 우승한 소식을 전했다. 하지만 경기도 수원종합운동장에서 경기가 치러진 사실 등에 대해서는 언급하지 않았다.)

The Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported on the 2025-2026 AFC AWCL final, stating, "The final match between our country's Hometown Team and Japan's Tokyo Verdy Beleza was held on the 23rd," and "In the final match to decide Asia's best women's football team (club team), our players defeated the Japanese players 1-0." The agency added, "At the awards ceremony, the winning cup and gold medals were awarded to our country's Hometown Team players, who achieved first place in the 2025-2026 Asian Football Confederation Women's Championship Holders' League, and the Best Player award was given to player Kim Kyong-yong." <<> Previously, when reporting the results of the semifinal match between Hometown Team and Suwon FC Women held on the 20th, the agency stated, "The semifinal match between our country's Hometown Team and South Korea's Suwon Team was held on the 20th in South Korea," mentioning the host country but not the specific venue. North Korean media did not report any details about the cheering efforts of the inter-Korean joint cheering squad organized by South Korean private groups on the 20th and 24th. <<> News of the North Korean women's football team's victory also appeared in the Rodong Sinmun, a newspaper read by North Korean residents. The newspaper reported the victory of the Hometown Team on page 3 without mentioning the match venue or the South Korean cheering squad. The paper stated, "The proud achievements of the Hometown Team's women's football players bring hope and great encouragement to all the people of the country who are upholding the decisions of the 9th Party Congress and steadfastly opening up the full prosperity era of our great nation." <<> The newspaper also published photos showing Hometown Team players hoisting the trophy and cheering at the awards ceremony, posing for a commemorative photo with the national flag unfurled after the ceremony, player Kim Kyong-yong celebrating after scoring a goal, and her receiving the tournament's Most Valuable Player (MVP) award. (조선중앙통신은 이날 2025-2026 AFC AWCL 결승전에 대해 “우리나라의 내고향팀이 일본의 도꾜 베르디 벨라자팀 사이의 결승 경기가 23일에 진행됐다”며 “아시아의 최우수녀자축구팀(구락부팀)을 결정하는 결승경기에서 우리 선수들은 일본선수들을 1:0으로 이겼다”고 보도했다. 통신은 “시상식에서는 2025년-2026년 아시아축구련맹 녀자선수권보유자련맹전에서 1위를 한 우리나라의 내고향팀 선수들에게 우승컵과 금메달이, 김경영선수에게 최우수선수상이 수여되였다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee: “Sites like Ilbe that Promote Mockery and Hatred Need to Be Considered for Closure” (李대통령 “일베처럼 조롱·혐오 조장하는 사이트, 폐쇄 검토 필요")
item.description:
President Lee: “Sites like Ilbe that Promote Mockery and Hatred Need to Be Considered for Closure” (李대통령 “일베처럼 조롱·혐오 조장하는 사이트, 폐쇄 검토 필요")

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 24th, citing the mockery of former President Roh Moo-hyun by some, that he would instruct the Cabinet meeting to review measures to punish such acts. (이재명 대통령은 24일 노무현 전 대통령에 대한 일각의 조롱 행위를 예로 들면서, 이런 행위를 처벌하기 위한 방안 검토를 국무회의에 지시하겠다고 밝혔다.)

On this day, President Lee shared on X a media report claiming that acts of mockery against former President Roh occurred on the 23rd at Bongha Village, where a memorial ceremony was held. The article reported that individuals presumed to be users of the online community “Ilbe (Ilgan Best Storage)” made a hand gesture symbolizing Ilbe while taking photos next to a statue of former President Roh at Bongha Village, mocking and insulting him. The former president attended the memorial ceremony held at Bongha Village. (이 대통령은 이날 X에 노 전 대통령의 추도식이 열린 23일 봉하마을에서 노 전 대통령에 대한 조롱 행위가 있었다고 주장하는 내용의 언론 보도를 공유했다. 해당 기사는, 온라인 커뮤니티 ‘일베(일간 베스트 저장소)’ 이용자로 추정되는 이들이 봉하마을에서 일베를 상징하는 손가락 표시를 한 채로 노 전 대통령의 동상 옆에서 사진을 찍으며 노 전 대통령을 조롱·모욕했다는 내용이다. 이 전 대통령은 봉하마을에서 열린 추도식에 참석했다.)

President Lee said on this day, “There are conflicting arguments: one that such acts of mockery and insult that foster social division and conflict, like Ilbe, should be protected under freedom of expression, and another that sanctions including punishment are necessary.” He added, “There was also controversy over the closure of Ilbe, wasn’t there?” (이 대통령은 이날 “일베처럼 조롱·모욕으로 사회 분열 갈등을 조장하는 데 대해 표현의 자유로 보호해야 한다는 주장과 처벌을 포함한 제재가 필요하다는 주장이 병존한다”며 “일베 폐쇄 논란도 있었지요”라고 했다.)

President Lee continued, “Under strict conditions, it seems necessary to publicly discuss and actually review allowing punitive and compensatory measures against mockery and hate speech, such as punishment, punitive damages, closure of sites like Ilbe that neglect and promote mockery and hatred, punitive damages, and fines. I will also instruct the Cabinet meeting on this matter.” (이 대통령은 이어 “엄격한 조건하에 조롱·혐오 표현에 대한 처벌과 징벌 배상, 일베처럼 조롱·혐오를 방치·조장하는 사이트 폐쇄, 징벌 배상, 과징금 등 필요 조치를 허용하는 데 대한 공론화와 실제 검토가 필요해 보인다”며 “국무회의에도 지시하겠다”고 했다.)

Recently, on May 18, President Lee had said regarding Starbucks, which held a discount event under the name “Tank Day,” “I am outraged by the subhuman, bottom-line behavior of those low-quality merchants. Corresponding moral, administrative, legal, and political responsibility must be imposed.” A Blue House official stated, “The president’s resolve to eradicate acts of historical distortion and desecration by those presumed to be far-right is firm.” (이 대통령은 최근 5월 18일에 ‘탱크 데이’라는 이름으로 할인 행사를 진행한 스타벅스를 향해 “저질 장사치의 비인간적 막장 행태에 분노한다”며 “그에 상응하는 도덕적, 행정적, 법적, 정치적 책임이 주어져야 할 것”이라고 했었다. 청와대 관계자는 “극우 성향으로 추정되는 이들의 역사 왜곡·모독 행위를 뿌리 뽑겠다는 대통령의 의지가 확고하다”고 전했다.)

item.title: Lee: "Closure of hate-tolerating sites like Ilbe, punitive damages, and fines need review" (李 “일베 등 혐오 방치 사이트 폐쇄·징벌적 손해배상·과징금 등 검토 필요”)
item.description:
Lee: "Closure of hate-tolerating sites like Ilbe, punitive damages, and fines need review" (李 “일베 등 혐오 방치 사이트 폐쇄·징벌적 손해배상·과징금 등 검토 필요”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 24th, "Public discourse and practical review are necessary for allowing measures under strict conditions, such as punishment and punitive damages for mockery and hate speech, and closure, punitive damages, and fines for sites that tolerate or incite mockery and hate, like Ilbe (Daily Best Storage)." (이재명 대통령은 24일 “조롱·혐오 표현의 처벌과 징벌적 손해배상, 일간베스트저장소(일베)처럼 조롱·혐오를 방치 및 조장하는 사이트의 폐쇄·징벌적 손해배상·과징금 등 필요한 조치를 엄격한 조건 아래 허용하는 데 대한 공론화와 실제 검토가 필요하다”고 했다.)

The President shared a report on X (formerly Twitter) that day stating, "Young people presumed to be Ilbe users visited Bongha Village, where the memorial ceremony for former President Roh Moo-hyun was held the previous day, and engaged in mockery," and made this remark. (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에서 ‘일베 이용자로 추정되는 청년들이 전날 노무현 전 대통령 추도식이 열린 봉하마을에 찾아와 조롱성 행동을 했다’는 보도를 공유하며 이같이 밝혔다.)

President Lee said, "There are coexisting claims that mocking and insulting, which incite social division and conflict like on Ilbe, should be protected as freedom of expression, and that sanctions including punishment are necessary," adding, "There has also been controversy over shutting down Ilbe." He then mentioned public debate on measures such as punishment, punitive damages, site closure, and fines, and said, "I will also instruct the Cabinet meeting," asking, "What are your opinions?" President Lee has shown a strong will to respond to mockery and hate speech regarding democratization movements or social tragedies, such as criticizing Starbucks Korea for planning a 'Tank Day' event on the anniversary of the May 18 Gwangju Democratization Movement. <<> Cho Soo-jin, a director of the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation, claimed that a visitor presumed to be an Ilbe user came to the 17th memorial ceremony for former President Roh Moo-hyun held the previous day and engaged in mockery, urging, "Please create a law punishing hate speech." (이 대통령은 “일베처럼 조롱 모욕으로 사회분열 갈등을 조장하는 데 대해 표현의 자유로 보호해야 한다는 주장과 처벌을 포함한 제재가 필요하다는 주장이 병존한다”며 “일베 폐쇄 논란도 있었다”고 했다. 그러면서 처벌, 징벌적 손해배상, 사이트 폐쇄, 과징금 등 조치의 공론화를 거론한 뒤 “국무회의에도 지시하겠다”며 “여러분 의견은 어떠시냐”고 물었다.이 대통령은 5·18 광주민주화항쟁 기념일을 맞아 ‘탱크 데이’ 이벤트를 기획한 스타벅스코리아를 질타하는 등 민주화운동이나 사회적 참사 등에 대한 조롱·혐오 표현에 대한 강력 대응 의지를 드러내고 있다.)

item.title: U.S. Defense and Veterans Affairs Secretaries Roll Up Sleeves for Memorial Day… Cleanse Veterans Memorial in the Rain (美현충일 맞아 팔 걷어붙인 국방·보훈 장관… 비 맞으며 참전용사비 대청소)
item.description:
U.S. Defense and Veterans Affairs Secretaries Roll Up Sleeves for Memorial Day… Cleanse Veterans Memorial in the Rain (美현충일 맞아 팔 걷어붙인 국방·보훈 장관… 비 맞으며 참전용사비 대청소 )

On the 23rd, two days before America’s Memorial Day (May 25), Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth and Secretary of Veterans Affairs Doug Collins visited the Vietnam Veterans Memorial at the National Mall in Washington, D.C., to conduct a “major cleanup” alongside volunteers. Despite rain throughout the day in Washington, D.C., the two secretaries braved the weather to honor the veterans. Last year, ahead of Memorial Day, the two secretaries made headlines by cleaning the Korean War Veterans Memorial, a symbol of the U.S.-South Korea alliance. (미국의 현충일인 ‘메모리얼 데이(Memorial Day·5월 25일)’를 이틀 앞둔 23일 피트 헤그세스 전쟁부(국방부) 장관과 더그 콜린스 보훈부 장관이 워싱턴 DC의 내셔널 몰에 있는 베트남 전쟁 참전용사 기념공원을 찾아 자원봉사자들과 함께 ‘대청소’를 진행했다. 이날 하루 종일 워싱턴 DC에 비가 내렸지만 두 장관은 비를 맞아가며 참전용사들을 기렸다. 지난해 메모리얼 데이를 앞두고는 두 장관이 한미 동맹의 상징인 6·25 전쟁 참전용사 기념공원을 찾아 청소를 진행한 것이 큰 화제가 됐다.)

Hegseth and Collins, along with volunteers, wielded mops and buckets to scrub away grime from the monument’s surfaces. The memorial wall, known as “The Wall,” bears the names of approximately 58,000 U.S. service members who were killed or went missing during the Vietnam War. Hegseth stated, “There is no better way to start the Memorial Day weekend than with this cleanup. We will forever honor the Americans who answered the call during the Vietnam War.” Collins added, “This cleanup is our way of remembering the sacrifices of our veterans. Everything we enjoy today is because of the blood they shed.” (헤그세스와 콜린스는 이날 자원 봉사자들과 함께 대걸레, 양동이를 들고 기념비 곳곳의 묵은 때를 벗겨냈다. 이른바 ‘더 월(The Wall)’이라 불리는 추모벽에는 베트남전에서 전사·실종된 미군 약 5만8000명의 이름이 새겨져 있다. 헤그세스는 “메모리얼 데이 연휴를 시작하기에 대청소보다 더 훌륭한 일은 없다”며 “베트남전 당시 소집에 응한 미국인들은 우리는 영원히 기릴 것”이라고 했다. 콜린스는 “대청소는 우리가 참전용사들의 희생을 기억하는 우리만의 방식”이라며 “오늘날 우리가 누리는 모든 것은 참전용사들이 흘린 피 때문”이라고 했다.)

On Memorial Day itself, May 25, at 2:00 p.m., a commemorative ceremony hosted by the Korean War Veterans Memorial Foundation (KWVMF) is scheduled to take place at the Korean War Veterans Memorial. The memorial features the “19 Soldiers” stainless steel sculpture, created by artist Frank Gaylord in 1995, and the “Wall of Remembrance,” established in 2022, which bears the names of 43,000 U.S. and South Korean soldiers who died in the Korean War along with the faces of 2,400 veterans. Last year, while thoroughly cleaning the statues and monuments at this park, Hegseth remarked, “The cleanup was an opportunity for me to remind my children what the Korean War was, what the strategic environment was like, why it was important, how many people sacrificed, and why we are still there (in Korea).” (메모리얼 데이 당일인 25일 오후 2시에는 한국전참전용사기념재단(KWVMF)이 주관하는 기념행사가 6·25 전쟁 참전용사 기념공원에서 열릴 예정이다. 공원에는 1995년 조각가 프랭크 게일로드가 제작한 스테인리스 스틸 조형물인 ’19인 용사상‘, 2022년 조성돼 6·25 때 전사한 한미 군인 4만3000명의 이름과 2400명의 참전용사들의 얼굴이 새겨진 ‘추모의 벽’이 있다. 헤그세스는 지난해 이 공원의 조각상과 기념비를 깨끗이 닦아내면서 “대청소는 나에게 6·25 전쟁이 무엇이었는지, 전략적 환경은 어땠는지, 왜 중요했는지, 얼마나 많은 사람이 희생됐는지, 왜 우리가 여전히 그곳(한국)에 있는지 등을 아이들에게 상기시키는 기회였다”고 했다.)

item.title: Song Eon-seok: "Party leader risk remains... Will decide on my position after the election" (송언석 “당대표 리스크 남아...선거 이후 거취 결정할 것”)
item.description:
Song Eon-seok: "Party leader risk remains... Will decide on my position after the election" (송언석 “당대표 리스크 남아...선거 이후 거취 결정할 것”)

People Power Party floor leader Song Eon-seok stated about campaigning under the "Jang Dong-hyuk one-top election committee system," saying, "There are indications that the party leader risk remains." <<> Appearing on TV Chosun's "Strong Rivals" on the 23rd, Song commented on the formation of the election committee, saying, "Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae also said it would be better if he refrained from showing his face in the region as much as possible. It seems the two parties are in a similar situation." This implies that both the Democratic Party and the People Power Party are facing a 'party leader risk' in the upcoming June 3 local elections. <<> Regarding the process of forming the election committee, Floor Leader Song explained, "Initially, when forming the election committee, many lawmakers expressed the opinion that 'it would be better for Representative Jang to step back,' so I conveyed that. Representative Jang partially agreed, so I recommended three senior lawmakers." It is known that Song recommended lawmakers Kim Gi-hyeon (5th term, Ulsan Nam-eul), Na Kyung-won (5th term, Seoul Dongjak-eul), and Ahn Cheol-soo (4th term, Gyeonggi Seongnam Bundang-gap). <<> However, Representative Jang did not accept these requests. Instead, he formed an election committee where he took the lead as co-standing election committee chairperson. In fact, the co-standing election committee chairs of the People Power Party include Shim Gyo-eon, a professor of real estate at Konkuk University; Yang Jun-mo, a professor of economics at Yonsei University; Lee Yun-jin, a professor at Konkuk University's Institute for Healthy Aging Society; and Choi Ji-ye, the youngest recruited talent and director of Jiye-su Corporation. Representative Jang is the only politician among them. This has led to assessments both inside and outside the party that "the election committee has been formed as a de facto 'one-top system' under Representative Jang." <<> Regarding public sentiment encountered during the election campaign, Floor Leader Song said, "I hear a lot of criticism urging the party leadership to do better. After the election ends, I will humbly accept the results and also decide on my own position." Song's term as floor leader lasts until June 15. This is interpreted to mean he could preemptively resign depending on the outcome of the June 3 local elections. <<> He also apologized for a comment made while explaining the background behind his absence from the May 18 Democratization Movement commemoration ceremony, where he said he "didn't go because it was dirty." Floor Leader Song stated, "I said that while talking with reporters under the premise of it being off the record, but as a result, listeners could have felt uncomfortable. I officially apologize for the parts that warrant an apology and acknowledge that it was wrong." (국민의힘 송언석 원내대표가 ‘장동혁 원톱 선대위 체제’로 유세에 나서는 데 대해 “당대표 리스크가 남아있다는 지적이 있는 상황”이라고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Lee Jun-seok on President Lee’s “Shutdown of Ilbe”: “If Politics Does Its Job, It Will Lose Its Ground” (이준석, 李대통령 “일베 폐쇄”에… “정치가 제 역할 하면 설 자리 잃어”)
item.description:
Lee Jun-seok on President Lee’s “Shutdown of Ilbe”: “If Politics Does Its Job, It Will Lose Its Ground” (이준석, 李대통령 “일베 폐쇄”에… “정치가 제 역할 하면 설 자리 잃어”)

Lee Jun-seok, leader of the Reform Party, stated on the 24th regarding President Lee Jae-myung’s mention of shutting down Ilbe (Ilgan Best Storage), “What the people want from the president is not something like closing the Ilbe website.” (이준석 개혁신당 대표가 24일 이재명 대통령이 일간베스트저장소(일베) 폐쇄 등을 거론한 데 대해 “국민이 대통령에게 원하는 것은 일베 사이트 폐쇄 따위가 아니다”라고 했다.)

In a Facebook post that morning, Lee expressed, “The vessel of a ruler is most starkly revealed when he fails to control personal anger.” (이 대표는 이날 오전 페이스북에 글을 올리고 “권력자의 그릇은 사사로운 분노를 다스리지 못할 때 가장 적나라하게 드러난다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

Earlier, President Lee shared a report on his social media platform X (formerly Twitter) stating that “young individuals presumed to be Ilbe users visited Bongha Village, where the memorial service for former President Roh Moo-hyun was held the previous day, and engaged in mocking behavior.” He wrote, “There is a need for public debate and actual review of allowing measures under strict conditions, such as punishment and punitive damages for mockery and hate speech, and the closure, punitive damages, and fines for sites like Ilbe that neglect and encourage mockery and hate.” (앞서 이 대통령은 자신의 소셜미디어 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에서 ‘일베 이용자로 추정되는 청년들이 전날 노무현 전 대통령 추도식이 열린 봉하마을에 찾아와 조롱성 행동을 했다’는 보도를 공유하며 “조롱·혐오 표현의 처벌과 징벌적 손해배상, 일간베스트저장소(일베)처럼 조롱·혐오를 방치 및 조장하는 사이트의 폐쇄·징벌적 손해배상·과징금 등 필요한 조치를 엄격한 조건 아래 허용하는 데 대한 공론화와 실제 검토가 필요하다”고 썼다.)

Lee stated, “With local elections just around the corner, President Lee Jae-myung’s focus is stuck on Starbucks stores, Netanyahu’s arrest warrant, and shutting down the Ilbe website.” He added, “Today, he’s even brought up closing Ilbe. The rhetoric of private retribution he wielded as Seongnam mayor, saying ‘if you’re caught, you’re finished,’ is now back in the hands of the nation’s highest authority.” (이 대표는 “지방선거를 코앞에 둔 이재명 대통령의 시선은 스타벅스 매장, 네타냐후 체포영장, 그리고 일베 사이트 폐쇄에 박혀 있다”며 “오늘은 일베 폐쇄까지 꺼내 들었다. 성남시장 시절 ‘걸리면 끝장’이라며 휘두르던 사적 응징의 어법이, 이제 국가 최고 권력의 손에 다시 들려 있다”고 했다.)

He said, “If the president becomes a sage ruler, Ilbe will lose its ground,” and “In a society where politics does its job and the people’s lives improve, Ilbe-style cynicism will be eradicated.” (그는 “대통령께서 성군이 되시면, 일베는 설 자리를 잃는다”며 “정치가 제 역할을 하고 국민의 삶이 풀리는 사회에서 일베식 냉소는 박멸된다”고 했다.)

Lee emphasized, “What the people want from the president is not something like closing the Ilbe website. They want justice where anyone who commits a crime stands trial, a ladder for young people to get a loan and secure a small home, and an ordinary daily life where buying a cup of coffee at a neighborhood café isn’t judged by political affiliation.” (이 대표는 “국민이 대통령에게 원하는 것은 일베 사이트 폐쇄 따위가 아니다”라며 “죄 지은 사람은 누구든 법정에 서는 정의, 청년이 대출 한 번 받아 작은 집 한 채 마련할 수 있는 사다리, 집 앞 카페에서 커피 한 잔 사 마셔도 정치색으로 재단당하지 않는 평범한 일상(을 원한다)”고 했다.)

He added, “The one the president should look at every day, reflect on, and rebuke is not Starbucks, Netanyahu, or Ilbe. It’s President Lee Jae-myung in the mirror—the ultimate output from Ilbe. Himself.” (그러면서 “지금 대통령이 매일 바라보며 성찰하고 꾸짖어야 할 상대는, 스타벅스도 네타냐후도 일베도 아니다”라며 “거울 속의 이재명 대통령, 일베 출신 최고의 아웃풋. 본인”이라고 했다.)

item.title: "What about Daejeon?" 'Queen of Elections' Park Geun-hye to Visit Lee Jang-woo's Campaign Tomorrow (“대전은요?” ‘선거의 여왕’ 박근혜, 내일 이장우 캠프 찾는다)
item.description:
"What about Daejeon?" 'Queen of Elections' Park Geun-hye to Visit Lee Jang-woo's Campaign Tomorrow (“대전은요?” ‘선거의 여왕’ 박근혜, 내일 이장우 캠프 찾는다)

Former President Park Geun-hye, known as the 'Queen of Elections,' will personally visit the campaign of People Power Party's Daejeon mayoral candidate Lee Jang-woo on the afternoon of the 25th to offer encouragement. It is unusual for former President Park to visit regions outside Daegu. (‘선거의 여왕’으로 불린 박근혜 전 대통령이 25일 오후 국민의힘 이장우 대전시장 후보 캠프를 직접 찾아 이 후보에 대한 격려에 나선다. 박 전 대통령이 대구 이외의 지역을 찾는 건 이례적이다.)

According to political circles on the 24th, former President Park plans to visit candidate Lee's campaign in Seo-gu, Daejeon, on the afternoon of the 25th to support him. A political insider explained, "This is a gesture to bolster candidate Lee, who has maintained his loyalty to the end." Candidate Lee is classified as a pro-Park figure, having opposed the impeachment of former President Park in 2016 during his time as a member of the National Assembly. (24일 정치권에 따르면 박 전 대통령은 25일 오후 대전 서구 이 후보 캠프를 찾아 이 후보를 지원할 계획이다. 정치권 관계자는 “끝까지 신의를 지켜온 이 후보에게 힘을 실어준다는 차원”이라고 설명했다. 이 후보는 국회의원 시절인 2016년 박 전 대통령 탄핵에 반대하는 등 친박 인사로 분류된다.)

Prior to Daejeon, former President Park will visit the birthplace of her late mother, Yuk Young-soo, in Okcheon, North Chungcheong Province. It is reported that multiple People Power Party figures, including North Chungcheong Province governor candidate Kim Young-hwan, Okcheon County governor candidate Jeon Sang-in, and lawmaker Park Deok-heum, will accompany her during this schedule. (대전에 앞서 박 전 대통령은 충북 옥천에 있는 모친 고(故) 육영수 여사의 생가를 방문한다. 이 일정에는 김영환 충북도지사 후보, 전상인 옥천군수 후보, 박덕흠 의원 등 국민의힘 인사가 다수 동행할 것으로 알려졌다.)

Earlier, on the 23rd, former President Park visited Chilseong Market in Buk-gu, Daegu, for a campaign rally supporting People Power Party's Daegu mayoral candidate Choo Kyung-ho. It was the first time in nine years since her impeachment in 2017 that former President Park participated in an on-site campaign rally ahead of an election. (앞서 박 전 대통령은 지난 23일 대구 북구 칠성시장을 찾아 추경호 국민의힘 대구시장 후보 지원 유세에 나섰다. 박 전 대통령이 선거를 앞두고 현장 유세에 나선 것은 2017년 탄핵 이후 9년 만이다.)

Appearing in an orange shirt and jeans, former President Park walked through Chilseong Market for about 30 minutes, greeting citizens. Hundreds of citizens and supporters gathered at the scene, chanting "President Park Geun-hye." Former President Park expressed support for candidate Choo, saying, "I believe candidate Choo will come up with good policies." (주황색 셔츠에 청바지 차림으로 나타난 박 전 대통령은 이날 약 30분간 칠성시장을 돌며 시민들과 인사를 나눴다. 이날 현장에는 시민과 지지자 수백 명이 몰려 “박근혜 대통령”을 연호했다. 박 전 대통령은 “추 후보가 좋은 정책을 마련할 것이라 생각한다”며 추 후보에게 힘을 실었다.)

Former President Park remarked, "I've heard that many people have been saying they'd like to see me or meet me." When asked if she had any intention of meeting Daegu mayoral candidate Kim Boo-kyum, she gave no particular response. (박 전 대통령은 “그동안 많은 분이 ‘저를 한번 봤으면 좋겠다, 만났으면 좋겠다’고 하는 얘기를 하셨다는 말씀을 전해 들었다”고 했다. 그는 김부겸 대구시장 후보를 만날 생각이 있느냐는 취지의 질문에는 별다른 대답을 하지 않았다.)

Alongside candidate Choo, others accompanying her on this schedule included People Power Party Daegu City Party Chair Lee In-seon, as well as lawmakers Joo Ho-young, Kim Seung-soo, Kwon Young-jin, Kim Ki-woong, Choi Eun-seok, Woo Jae-jun, and Yoo Young-ha. (이날 일정에는 추 후보뿐 아니라 국민의힘 이인선 대구시당위원장을 비롯해 주호영·김승수·권영진·김기웅·최은석·우재준·유영하 의원 등이 동행했다.)

item.title: North Korea’s ‘Naegohyang’ Team Departs for North via China from Incheon Airport (北 ‘내고향’ 선수단 인천공항서 中 경유해 北으로)
item.description:
North Korea’s ‘Naegohyang’ Team Departs for North via China from Incheon Airport (北 ‘내고향’ 선수단 인천공항서 中 경유해 北으로)

The North Korean women’s club football team ‘Naegohyang Women’s Football Team,’ which visited South Korea on the 17th to participate in the 2025–2026 Asian Football Confederation (AFC) Women’s Champions League (AWCL), will depart for Beijing from Incheon Airport at 3:30 PM on the 24th. <<> According to the Ministry of Unification on this day, the Naegohyang team will depart from Incheon Airport on an Air China flight to Beijing at 3:30 PM. After winning the semifinal against Suwon FC Women at Suwon General Sports Complex on the 17th, the Naegohyang team defeated Japan’s Tokyo Verdy Beleza in the final the previous day, the 23rd, to win the Asian Women’s Club Football Championship. <<> North Korean media reported on the Naegohyang team’s victory in the AFC Women’s Champions League final the previous day but made no mention of the match being held at Suwon General Sports Complex in Gyeonggi Province. There was also no mention of the ‘Joint Cheering Squad,’ composed of South Korean private organizations supported by 3 billion won from the Inter-Korean Cooperation Fund, cheering for the Naegohyang team. <<> Initially, under AFC regulations stating that teams facing each other in the semifinals share the same accommodation, the Naegohyang team was set to stay at the same hotel as the Suwon FC Women squad. However, on the day of the Naegohyang team’s arrival in South Korea, the Suwon FC Women team moved to a different nearby hotel in Suwon. The ‘Joint Cheering Squad’ drew controversy during the semifinal match between Suwon FC and the Naegohyang team for cheering louder when Naegohyang scored or applauding when Suwon FC’s Ji So-yeon missed a penalty kick. Suwon FC Women’s head coach Park Ki-young said to reporters after losing the semifinal, “We are the South Korean women’s football team Suwon FC Women. I was very upset because of what happened in the opposite stands (the Joint Cheering Squad) during the match.” <<> The North Korean delegation entered South Korea on the 17th via Beijing, China, arriving at Incheon Airport. Upon entry, they left the airport without responding to any questions from reporters or greetings from those welcoming them. This visit to South Korea by a North Korean delegation was the first in about eight years since the International Table Tennis Federation (ITTF) World Tour Grand Finals held in Incheon in 2018. It was also the first since North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un defined inter-Korean relations as ‘hostile belligerent relations’ at the end of 2023. (지난 17일 2025-2026시즌 아시아축구연맹(AFC) 여자 챔피언스리그(AWCL) 경기 참가를 위해 방남(訪南)한 북한의 여자 클럽 축구팀 ‘내고향여자축구단’이 24일 오후 3시30분 인천공항에서 베이징으로 출국한다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk on Lee’s Criticism of ‘Siren Event’: “Loss of Reason… Blurting Out Without Checking Facts” (장동혁, 李 ‘사이렌 행사’ 질타에 “이성 상실… 앞뒤 없이 지른다”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk on Lee’s Criticism of ‘Siren Event’: “Loss of Reason… Blurting Out Without Checking Facts” (장동혁, 李 ‘사이렌 행사’ 질타에 “이성 상실… 앞뒤 없이 지른다”)

<<>> Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, stated on the 24th regarding President Lee Jae-myung’s remarks the previous day about Starbucks Korea’s ‘Siren Mug Event’ held two years ago on the 10th anniversary of the Sewol Ferry Disaster (April 16), calling it an “act of filial impiety,” that “the President has lost his reason. He’s blurting things out without properly checking and without any sense of context.” <<> Representative Jang posted on Facebook that morning, saying, “We’d better mark all disaster dates on the calendar now and avoid anything that even remotely touches them,” arguing that according to the President’s logic, “on April 16, we shouldn’t even use ‘Siren Order.’ We’d have to cover up the Starbucks sign with the ‘Siren’ logo too.” <<> Earlier, President Lee mentioned Starbucks Korea’s release of a ‘Siren Mug’ on the 10th anniversary of the Sewol Ferry Disaster—following its controversial ‘Tank Day’ event that was seen as belittling the May 18 Democratic Uprising—and criticized it as an “act of contempt toward the disaster victims like beasts” and “a shameless merchant’s act of filial impiety.” <<> Representative Jang countered, “From the start, there was no event. It was just a routine product launch announcement saying a new Siren Classic product was released. ‘Siren’ is Starbucks’ symbol and a common name applied to all products bearing the Starbucks logo.” The Siren, a mermaid from Greek mythology depicted as luring humans to ruin with her enchanting song, has been used in Starbucks’ logo since its founding in 1971 to convey the idea of captivating people with coffee. <<> Representative Jang then launched a counterattack against President Lee. He said, “Lee Jae-myung moved into Cheong Wa Dae on December 29 last year. Photos of him smiling broadly while meeting reporters appeared widely. That day was exactly the first anniversary of the Muan Airport disaster.” He added, “He should have gone to Muan. What would you say if I criticized you for moving into Cheong Wa Dae on that day?” ()

item.title: President Lee: "Hatred does not cease by hatred, but only by compassion" (李대통령 “미움은 미움으로 사라지지 않고, 오직 자비로써 사라진다”)
item.description:
President Lee: "Hatred does not cease by hatred, but only by compassion" (李대통령 “미움은 미움으로 사라지지 않고, 오직 자비로써 사라진다”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated in his speech on Buddha's Birthday on the 24th, "The government of the people's sovereignty will take the precious words of the Buddha as its guiding light," and added, "I will create a nation that pays closer attention to the lives of each and every citizen and listens to the voices of the lowest." (이재명 대통령이 24일 부처님 오신 날 축사에서 “국민주권 정부는 부처님의 귀한 말씀을 등불로 삼겠다”며 “국민 한 사람 한 사람의 삶을 더 세심하게 살피고, 가장 낮은 곳의 목소리에 귀 기울이는 나라를 만들겠다”고 밝혔다.)

President Lee made these remarks while attending the "Ceremony Celebrating Buddha's Birthday, Buddhist Year 2570 (2026)" held at Jogyesa Temple on this day. President Lee said, "The teachings of the Buddha have shared our joys and sorrows throughout our long history, healing the pain of the people and serving as a sanctuary for marginalized neighbors whenever we faced national crises and grief." He added, "Even in the midst of war, poverty, disasters, and social conflicts, the lanterns of temples never went out, and that is why our people, whenever they grew weary of life, could pause for a moment in front of a temple and find peace of mind." <<> He further emphasized, "In particular, the Buddha's teaching that all sentient beings should understand rather than reject each other and harmonize rather than confront has been a steadfast pillar that has made our society a stronger community." Quoting the Buddha's words, "Hatred does not cease by hatred, but only by compassion," he said, "Our society now desperately needs the spirit of consideration and understanding that harmonizes and embraces different thoughts, and a warm heart striving for coexistence and mutual prosperity rather than every man for himself." <<> President Lee pledged, "I will do my utmost to create a 'government that saves the lives of the people' and put into practice the teaching that 'all people are noble and everyone is equal.'" He continued, "I will deeply engrave the spirit of 'won-yung-hoe-tong' (perfect integration and communication) in my heart and overcome the crises facing the people and the nation with united strength." He expressed his hope, "May each lotus lantern that lights up the entire nation today become a ray of hope connecting our hearts and illuminate the Republic of Korea as an even warmer community." <<> Earlier that morning, in a post on Facebook, President Lee also emphasized the spirit of 'won-yung-hoe-tong' and harmony, stating, "The teachings of the Buddha, born on the road, have shared our joys and sorrows throughout our long history." (이 대통령은 이날 조계사에서 열린 ‘불기 2570년(2026년) 부처님 오신 날 봉축 법요식’에 참석해 이같이 말했다. 이 대통령은 “부처님의 가르침은 오랜 세월 우리 삶에서 고락을 함께해 왔으며 국가적 위기와 슬픔을 맞이할 때마다 국민의 아픔을 치유하고, 소외된 이웃의 안식처가 됐다”면서 “전쟁과 가난, 재난과 사회적 갈등 속에서도 사찰의 등불은 꺼지지 않았고, 그렇기에 우리 국민은 삶에 지칠 때마다 사찰 앞에서 잠시 걸음을 멈추고 마음의 평안을 얻을 수 있었다”고 했다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon: “Fighting to the People Power Party Candidates Joining Conservative Reconstruction, Do Well” (한동훈 “보수재건 공감하는 국힘 후보들 파이팅, 선전하시라”)
item.description:
Han Dong-hoon: “Fighting to the People Power Party Candidates Joining Conservative Reconstruction, Do Well” (한동훈 “보수재건 공감하는 국힘 후보들 파이팅, 선전하시라”)

Independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, running in the Busan North Gap by-election for the National Assembly, said on the 24th, “Fighting to the People Power Party candidates who join in conservative reconstruction.” <<> Meeting with reporters at Unsusa Temple in Sasang-gu, Busan on Buddha’s Birthday, candidate Han stated, “There are many People Power Party candidates who desire a conservative reconstruction based on the constitution, facts, and common sense.” He added, “I hope the People Power Party candidates who join in conservative reconstruction will gain more strength and do well.” <<> This is interpreted as a remark targeting People Power Party Supreme Council member Shin Dong-wook. On the 22nd, during a campaign support event for People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik, Supreme Council member Shin met Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo and said, “Fighting, Ha Jung-woo” and “I hope you do well.” Candidate Han is seen as retorting with “Fighting to the People Power Party candidates.” <<> Referring to the People Power Party’s pro-power faction, candidate Han said, “With that line, conservatives will also lose the 2028 general election and the 2030 presidential election,” adding, “President Yoon might serve a second term (through constitutional amendment).” He continued, “Now, let’s overcome (internal conflicts) and fight together. I will take to heart the minds of those who fervently support me, those who don’t support me but say ‘still, you’re the only one,’ and those who ‘still dislike you.’” <<> Some in the opposition are also discussing the possibility of a pan-conservative election alliance in the Busan region. In fact, it is reported that among some People Power Party lawmakers in Busan, there are calls for “candidate Han to appeal for support for People Power Party candidates.” <<> A People Power Party lawmaker from Busan said, “It is true that the People Power Party’s momentum has stalled, especially in Western Busan, where the Democratic Party’s influence is strong,” adding, “To overturn the difficult landscape, an election alliance with independent candidate Han is desperately needed.” <<> People Power Party lawmaker Park Soo-young (re-elected, Busan Nam-gap) also wrote on the party’s lawmaker group chat on the 21st, “My district, Busan Nam-gu, is a place that wins by 10-15 percentage points (over the Democratic Party), but now it’s a narrow deficit,” adding, “We’re holding the line on the ground, but without ‘special measures’ from the Busan city party and the central party to change the game, the election will be difficult.” <<> Regarding the meaning of ‘special measures,’ an aide to lawmaker Park explained, “It was not made with a specific candidate’s withdrawal in mind,” adding, “We asked the party leadership to step in so that options like not just unification, but also candidate Han appealing for support for People Power Party candidates in Busan, could be pursued.” (부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 무소속 한동훈 후보가 24일 “보수 재건에 동참하는 국민의힘 후보들, 파이팅하시라”고 했다.)

item.title: Could This Be a Family’s Glory?… The Diplomat Who Threw the Ceremonial First Pitch at a Major League Game Featuring Kim Ha-seong (어쩌면 가문의 영광?… 메이저리그 김하성 경기에 시구자로 나선 이 외교관)
item.description:
Could This Be a Family’s Glory?… The Diplomat Who Threw the Ceremonial First Pitch at a Major League Game Featuring Kim Ha-seong (어쩌면 가문의 영광?… 메이저리그 김하성 경기에 시구자로 나선 이 외교관 )

The Consulate General of the Republic of Korea in Atlanta reported that Consul General Lee Jun-ho threw the ceremonial first pitch at a Major League Baseball (MLB) game between the Atlanta Braves and the Chicago Cubs, held at Truist Park in Atlanta, Georgia, on the 13th. This first pitch was part of Asian American and Pacific Islander (AAPI) Heritage Month, and events promoting Korean culture, such as performances, were held before the game. The Braves currently feature Korean player Kim Ha-seong as their shortstop, and as more Korean players enter MLB, public diplomacy through baseball is increasing. <<> Every May, during AAPI Heritage Month, each MLB team hosts various events targeting loyal Asian fans. This also reflects MLB’s efforts to reach out to new fan bases, as its popularity in the U.S. has declined. Atlanta has a large Korean community, second only to those in New Jersey and California, and last year, an “Asian Night” event featured performances like lion dances, food trucks selling Korean cuisine, and K-culture merchandise. Georgia, a notable economic growth engine in the southern U.S., has been described as “living off South Korean companies” due to the concentrated investments by Korean firms in the country. Thanks to Consul General Lee’s ceremonial pitch, the Braves defeated the Cubs 4-1 on that day. <<> In San Francisco, where Lee Jung-hoo plays, Consul General Lim Jung-taek introduced Korean culture and threw the ceremonial first pitch at a Giants home game at Oracle Park last year. This event also featured traditional Korean music performances and K-cover dance routines, drawing attention from spectators, and offered limited-edition souvenirs, which received a great response. A year earlier, at a Mariners home game at T-Mobile Park in Seattle, Consul General Seo Eun-ji threw the ceremonial first pitch. The Mariners were the team where Lee Dae-ho played in 2016. In Japan, where baseball is as popular as in Korea, diplomats often take the mound for ceremonial pitches. In 2022, then-New York Consul General stepped onto the mound for a first pitch at a Mets game, but starting pitcher Max Scherzer refused to yield the spot until the end, causing a mishap where the diplomat couldn’t throw the pitch. The team later issued a formal apology. (지난 13일 조지아주(州) 애틀란타 트루이스트 파크에서 치러진 애틀란타 브레이브스와 시카고 컵스 간 메이저리그(MLB) 경기에서 이준호 총영사가 시구를 했다고 주애틀란타총영사관이 전했다. 이날 시구는 ‘아시아계 미국인·태평양 도서민 유산의 달(AAPI Heritage Month)’을 맞아 이뤄진 것으로 경기에 앞서 한국 문화를 알리는 공연 등 행사도 열렸다고 한다. 브레이브스는 현재 한국의 김하성 선수가 유격수로 활동하고 있는데, 한국 선수의 MLB 진출이 늘면서 야구를 고리로 한 여러 공공 외교가 이뤄지고 있다.)

item.title: Kim Sang-wook of the Opposition: "Suspends Ulsan Mayoral Candidate Unification Poll… Signs of Intervention by Specific Forces" (與 김상욱 “울산시장 단일화 경선 중단…특정 세력 개입 정황”)
item.description:
Kim Sang-wook of the Opposition: "Suspends Ulsan Mayoral Candidate Unification Poll… Signs of Intervention by Specific Forces" (與 김상욱 “울산시장 단일화 경선 중단…특정 세력 개입 정황”)

As the Democratic Party of Korea and the Progressive Party are conducting a public opinion poll to unify their candidates for Ulsan mayor, Kim Sang-wook, the Democratic Party candidate, stated on the 24th, "The polling agency discovered 'anomalies' and suspended the survey." Kim's camp added, "Circumstances suggesting systematic intervention by certain forces have been found. We have concluded that it is no longer possible to proceed with the unification primary in the current manner." (더불어민주당과 진보당이 울산시장 후보 단일화를 위한 여론조사를 진행 중인 가운데, 김상욱 민주당 후보 측이 24일 “여론조사기관에서 ‘특이사항’을 발견해 여론조사를 중단했다”고 밝혔다. 김 후보 측은 “일부 세력의 조직적 개입이 의심되는 정황이 발견되고 있다”며 “저희로선 더 이상 현재 방식으로 단일화 경선을 진행하는 것이 불가능하다는 결론에 이르렀다”고 했다.)

Kim Du-kwan, former lawmaker and head of Kim Sang-wook's general election campaign headquarters, issued a statement saying, "This is because we risk an anti-democratic situation where Ulsan citizens' right to choose could be infringed upon due to the machinations of specific forces." He added, "We held an emergency meeting at the general election campaign headquarters and decided to suspend the public opinion poll," but emphasized, "This is absolutely not about abandoning or rejecting unification, nor is it a violation of the agreement." (김상욱 후보 총괄선대본부장을 맡은 김두관 전 의원은 이날 입장문에서 “자칫 특정 세력의 농간에 의해 울산 시민의 선택권이 침해받을 반민주적 상황이 도래될 수 있기 때문”이라며 이같이 밝혔다. 김 전 의원은 “총괄선대본부에서 긴급회의를 개최하여 여론조사 중단을 결정했다”면서도 “절대 단일화를 포기하거나 거절하는 것이 아니며 합의를 위반하려는 것도 아니다”라고 했다.)

He further stated, "There is a firm standard that the method of unification must reflect the public opinion of all Ulsan citizens without distortion," and added, "Illegal interference in a primary constitutes the crime of election obstruction, a serious offense under the Public Official Election Act. We will thoroughly investigate whether specific forces have interfered with the intent to obstruct the primary." (그러면서 “단일화의 방식은 ‘울산 시민 전체의 여론이 왜곡됨 없이 반영되는 방식’이어야 한다는 확고한 기준이 있다”며 “경선에 불법적 개입을 하면 ‘경선방해죄’라는 공직선거법상 중죄에 해당한다. 특정 세력의 경선방해 목적 개입이 있는지 여부도 더 철저히 조사하겠다”고 했다.)

In response, Kim Jong-hoon of the Progressive Party expressed opposition, stating, "The unilateral suspension of the public opinion poll violates the spirit of the unification agreement and is unacceptable." Kim's campaign chief, Bang Seok-su, said in a statement, "The public opinion poll for the Ulsan mayoral candidate unification primary between the Democratic Party and the Progressive Party is proceeding as agreed upon by both sides," and added, "The Progressive Party has not identified any anomalies. Although Kim Sang-wook's camp claims suspicion of interference by specific forces, we have not been notified of any specific evidence or basis." (이에 대해 김종훈 진보당 후보 측은 “여론조사 일방적 중단 선언은 단일화 합의 정신을 어기는 것으로 납득할 수 없다”며 반발했다. 김 후보 방석수 선대본부장은 입장문에서 “민주당과 진보당의 울산시장 후보 단일화 경선 여론조사는 양측이 합의한 대로 진행되고 있다”며 “진보당은 특이한 점을 파악한 것이 없다. 김상욱 후보 측에서 특정 세력 개입이 의심된다고 하는데, 구체적으로 어떤 것인지 확인된 근거를 통보받은 바도 없다”고 했다.)

He continued, "We express strong regret over this unilateral declaration, which goes against the spirit of the agreement and the public's demand to unite and overcome the insurrection," and demanded, "We call for a sincere attitude and stance from Kim Sang-wook's camp." (이어 “합의 정신에도 어긋나고, 힘을 모아 내란을 청산하라는 시민의 요구에도 맞지 않는 일방적 선언에 대한 강력한 유감을 표한다”며 “김상욱 후보 측의 진정성 있는 태도와 입장을 요구한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee's Starbucks 'Siren Event' Criticism... Opposition Candidates in Busan Call It "Bizarre Provocation" (李 스벅 ‘세이렌 이벤트’ 때리기에…野 부산 후보들 “기괴한 선동”)
item.description:
Lee's Starbucks 'Siren Event' Criticism... Opposition Candidates in Busan Call It "Bizarre Provocation" (李 스벅 ‘세이렌 이벤트’ 때리기에…野 부산 후보들 “기괴한 선동”)

As President Lee Jae-myung continues to post critical remarks about Starbucks' marketing on social media, opposition politicians have pushed back. Following the controversy over Starbucks Korea's "Tank Day" incident related to the May 18 Democratic Uprising, the president criticized the company for holding a "Siren Event" on the April 16 Sewol Ferry disaster memorial day. The Starbucks controversy has since emerged as a key issue in the upcoming June 3 local elections and parliamentary by-elections. <<> Seo Ji-yeon, spokesperson for People Power Party Busan mayoral candidate Park Hyung-joon, said on the 24th, "The Starbucks situation is going from bad to worse. Starbucks' event was clearly a mistake. The company immediately apologized, and the responsible CEO was dismissed. After that, it should be left to consumers to judge." She added, "Nevertheless, it is excessive interference bordering on killing a business for the president and government to come out and incite a boycott. This will inevitably have a negative impact on the economy." <<> People Power Party candidate Park Min-sik for Busan's North Gap district also said on the same day, "President Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party's crackdown on businesses has spiraled into a level of irrational conspiracy theories. The head of state is leading the charge to portray a major corporation's normal marketing as an act of impiety, acting as the vanguard of a boycott movement." Park added, "Starbucks has been running regular promotions every Tuesday, and April 16, 2024, was just an ordinary Tuesday. Dragging in the Greek mythological tale of shipwrecks over a brand logo used worldwide for over 50 years and linking it to the Sewol ferry disaster to incite public hatred is nothing short of bizarre." <<> Independent candidate Han Dong-hoon for Busan's North Gap district said, "When a company's management makes a wrong decision, the market punishes them—that's the Korean system. For the president and public officials to mobilize state power and punish a company with a 'gotcha' attitude undermines the Korean system." Han added, "Is the Democratic Party's main enemy North Korea, or is it Starbucks?" (이재명 대통령이 연일 스타벅스의 마케팅을 두고 연일 비판적인 글을 SNS에 올리는 가운데, 야권 정치인들이 반발했다. 이 대통령은 스타벅스코리아의 5·18 민주화 운동 관련 ‘탱크 데이’ 논란에 이어, 4·16 세월호 참사 추모일에 ‘세이렌 이벤트’를 했다고 비판했다. 이후 스타벅스 논란은 이번 6·3 지방선거 및 국회의원 재·보궐선거의 주요 쟁점으로 떠올랐다.)

item.title: Lee Jae-myung and Kim Hye-kyung Inspect Baekun Valley in Pocheon Together (이재명·김혜경, 함께 포천 백운계곡 점검)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung and First Lady Kim Hye-kyung visited Baekun Valley in Pocheon, Gyeonggi Province, on the afternoon of the 24th, a holiday for Buddha's Birthday, after concluding their schedule in Andong, North Gyeongsang Province. They personally inspected the usage status of streams and valleys as well as summer safety management conditions. Baekun Valley in Pocheon is a place where President Lee had strongly promoted renovation projects during his tenure as Gyeonggi Province Governor. (이재명 대통령 부부가 부처님오신날 연휴인 24일 오후 경북 안동 일정을 마치고 경기 포천시 백운계곡을 찾아 하천·계곡 이용 실태와 여름철 안전 관리 상황을 직접 점검했다. 포천 백운계곡은 이 대통령이 경기도지사 재임 시절 강력하게 정비 사업을 했던 곳이다.)

According to the presidential office, Baekun Valley in Pocheon had been plagued by over 1,600 illegal facilities and rampant illegal business activities, such as arbitrary seating fees. Through persistent communication and persuasion with merchant associations and others during his time as governor, President Lee pushed for renovations, and it has now been transformed into a clean rest area accessible to everyone, the presidential office explained. (청와대에 따르면, 과거 포천 백운계곡은 1600여 개의 불법 시설이 난립하고 고무줄 자릿세 등 불법 영업 행위가 성행했었다. 이 대통령은 도지사 시절 상인조합 등과의 끈질긴 소통과 설득을 통해 정비를 추진했고, 현재는 누구나 자유롭게 이용할 수 있는 청정 휴식 공간으로 탈바꿈했다는 게 청와대의 설명이다.)

A citizen who came from Namyangju that day expressed gratitude, saying, "The water is great, and I've visited often since I was young. But from a few years ago, I can enjoy it comfortably without paying seating fees, so I come every year." Other citizens also said, "Thank you for making the country great," and "I watch you daily on YouTube." (이날 남양주에서 왔다는 한 시민은 “물이 좋아 어릴 때부터 자주 왔는데, 몇 년 전부터는 자릿세를 내지 않고 편하게 즐길 수 있어 매년 찾고 있다”며 감사의 뜻을 전했다. 다른 시민들도 “나라를 훌륭하게 만들어줘서 감사하다” “유튜브로 매일 보고 있다”고 했다.)

President Lee personally greeted children playing in the valley who waved and cheered. In particular, he grabbed the wet hand of a child showing off a plastic bottle containing tadpoles and said, "Oh, it's cold!" with a bright smile. First Lady Kim Hye-kyung also approached citizens, asking, "Is there anything inconvenient?" and "Stay healthy," and kindly asked the children, "Did you eat something delicious?" (이 대통령은 계곡에서 물놀이를 하던 아이들이 손을 흔들며 환호하자 일일이 인사를 나눴다. 특히 올챙이가 담긴 페트병을 자랑하는 아이의 젖은 손을 잡으며 “앗 차갑다”고 환하게 웃어 보이기도 했다. 김혜경 여사 역시 시민들에게 “불편한 것은 없으시냐” “건강하시라”고 안부를 묻고, 아이들에게 “맛있는 것 먹었니?”라며 친근하게 다가갔다.)

The presidential couple shook hands with merchants around the valley to gauge the on-site economic conditions. When President Lee asked, "It's getting hotter, but are sales going well? How do you operate in the winter?" one merchant explained the situation, saying, "In winter, the Baekun Valley Winter Festival is held, drawing many citizens." (이 대통령 부부는 계곡 주변 상인들과도 악수하며 현장 경기 체감도를 살폈다. 이 대통령이 “날씨가 더워지는데 장사가 잘되는지, 겨울철에는 어떻게 운영하는지” 묻자, 한 상인은 “겨울에는 백운계곡 동장군 축제가 열려 시민들이 많이 찾는다”고 현황을 설명했다.)

President Lee told merchants and citizens, "If you need anything, feel free to request support anytime," and added, "If there are things that need improvement or maintenance, let me know, and I'll have the Minister of the Interior and Safety take care of it." (이 대통령은 상인과 시민들에게 “필요한 것이 있으면 언제든 지원 요청을 해달라”며 “시설 보완이나 정비 등 필요한 부분을 말씀하시면 행정안전부 장관에게 챙기라고 하겠다”고 했다.)

President Lee walked along the wooden deck path above the valley, carefully examining the risk of valley flooding due to heavy summer rains and the management status of hazardous facilities. He especially paused in front of a neglected sledding slope nearby to conduct a focused on-site inspection. (이 대통령은 계곡 위 나무 데크길을 도보로 이동하며 여름철 집중호우로 인한 계곡 범람 위험성과 위험 시설 관리 상태를 꼼꼼히 들여다봤다. 특히 인근에 방치된 눈썰매장 앞에서는 잠시 걸음을 멈추고 현장 상황을 집중 점검했다.)

After completing the on-site inspection, President Lee called the Minister of the Interior and Safety and instructed, "Expand cleaning staff support around the valley ahead of summer and significantly strengthen safety management," urging special attention. This aligns with his previous emphasis at a Cabinet meeting that "although natural disasters cannot be fundamentally prevented, the damage can be greatly reduced through the government's dedication and efforts." (현장 점검을 마친 이 대통령은 행정안전부 장관에게 전화를 걸어 “여름철을 앞두고 계곡 주변의 청소 인력 지원을 확대하고, 안전 관리를 대폭 강화하라”고 지시하며 각별히 신경 쓸 것을 당부했다. 전날 국무회의에서 “자연재해를 근원적으로 막을 수는 없지만 정부의 정성과 노력으로 피해는 얼마든지 줄일 수 있다”고 강조한 기조의 연장선이다.)

Meanwhile, after communicating with citizens, the presidential couple visited a restaurant in a commercial building at the valley entrance with their aides, sharing a dinner of chicken stew and acorn jelly to conclude their on-site visit to Pocheon. (한편, 시민들과 소통을 마친 이 대통령 부부는 참모진과 함께 계곡 입구의 한 상가 식당에 들러 닭볶음탕과 도토리묵 등으로 저녁 식사를 함께하며 포천 현장 방문 일정을 마무리했다.)
